goal: Build me a Python tool that turns a GitHub repository into a readable Markdown context snapshot I can give an LLM. Let me supply a repository URL, optionally a branch and subfolder, choose file extensions and a per-file line limit, and get repository metadata, dependency summaries, a directory tree and selected text-file contents in deterministic order. Respect .gitignore and common generated/dependency directories, don't include secret environment files by default, skip non-text files, and clearly identify truncated files instead of making the snapshot look complete. Support private repositories with a token kept out of the output, show a useful error when cloning or reading fails, and clean up temporary checkouts even after failure. Give me a CLI and a simple local Streamlit page for generating and downloading the same snapshot; no hosted service is necessary. Keep the core independent of the UI so it can be checked with a small local fixture repository instead of real network requests.

tasks.title: Specify extension and ignore filtering in a deterministic file tree.
acceptance: Show selected .py files and the declared root label.
Exclude other extensions, node_modules and caller-ignored files.
An entirely ignored tree contains only the root line.

tasks.title: Specify dependency summaries from requirements and project metadata.
acceptance: Recognize Python from requirements.txt and pyproject.toml.
Include the source filename and dependency entries.
Formatting whitespace is not part of the contract.

tasks.title: Specify repository, branch and subfolder extraction from simple GitHub URLs.
acceptance: Normalize the repository to a canonical .git URL.
Preserve simple branch names and nested subfolder paths.
Do not guess slash-containing branch semantics.

tasks.title: Specify UTF-8 text recognition with invalid-byte controls.
acceptance: Valid Turkish UTF-8 text is recognized.

tasks.title: Specify scoped snapshots, sorted content, truncation, secret exclusion and cleanup.
acceptance: Preserve branch/subfolder and honor the public clone injection contract.
Respect .gitignore, extension, symlink and dependency-directory exclusions.
Show truncation and deterministic multi-file order without leaking tokens.
Owned checkouts are deleted after successful snapshot creation.

tasks.title: Specify shared CLI/UI behavior and invalid-URL rejection before cloning.
acceptance: CLI and UI wrappers invoke the same operation with identical arguments.
A non-HTTPS GitHub URL fails before clone is called.

tasks.title: Verify documented delivery and live UI/backend integration separately.
acceptance: Actual CLI/Streamlit event wiring and private authentication remain manual checks. Slash-containing branch names remain unresolved.
